mode.title: Mode
mode.description: latest = newest value per series with the moves over a week, month, quarter and year and where the level sits in its own range. history = one row per series per date. catalogue = list every series this actor covers.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: credit (corporate bond spreads), volatility (VIX and friends), rates (Treasury yields, curve spreads, inflation expectations), conditions (official financial conditions and stress indexes), dollar (trade weighted dollar). Empty returns every category.

series.title: Specific series (optional)
series.description: Exact series identifiers such as BAMLH0A0HYM2 or VIXCLS. Overrides categories. Run catalogue mode to see every covered identifier.

lookbackDays.title: Context window (days)
lookbackDays.description: Latest mode. The trailing window used for the percentile rank, the high, the low and the median. 365 gives the level in the context of the past year.

daysBack.title: Days back
daysBack.description: History mode. How far back to pull, counting from the end date.

startDate.title: Start date (optional)
startDate.description: History mode. YYYY-MM-DD. Overrides days back.

endDate.title: End date (optional)
endDate.description: History mode. YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

maxRows.title: Max rows per run
maxRows.description: Cap on rows returned. Controls total cost.
